extracted.intended_audience: authors / mathematicians preparing to submit a manuscript to Compositio Mathematica
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for authors on how to submit manuscripts to the journal Compositio Mathematica, including accepted file formats, submission routes, account requirements, and preferred practices for sending source files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission of PDF or PS
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a pdf or ps file electronically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal partners with a secure submission system to handle manuscript submissions. Click 'Proceed to submission system' to continue to the partner's website and upload a pdf or ps file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative: email with web address to obtain file
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, send an e-mail to one of the managing editors or to editors@compositio.nl with a web address (e.g. a math-arXive address) where we can find a ps file or pdf file of your paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing a web address (such as an arXiv URL) where the editors can retrieve a ps/pdf is an accepted alternative to electronic upload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sending (La)TeX source by mail (less preferable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sending a (La)TeX version by mail is also possible, but is less preferable as it may lead to (teXnical) problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should avoid sending LaTeX source unless necessary because it can cause technical issues; prefer pdf/ps or an accessible web address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include corresponding author's address when sending source
rubrics_metrics.description: Please add the address of the corresponding author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When sending files (especially LaTeX source) by mail or email, include the corresponding author's postal/email address so the editors can contact the author if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account required for partner submission system
rubrics_metrics.description: You will need an account for the submission system, which is separate to your Cambridge Core account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For login and submission support, visit the submission and support pages referenced by the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review author instructions and preparing materials before submitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Please review this journal's author instructions, particularly the 'preparing your materials' page, before submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should consult the journal's detailed author instructions and preparatory guidance to ensure their submission meets format and policy expectations prior to submission.
